name: AI Clothes Changer Free
tagline: Free AI clothes changer: upload a photo, pick or describe an outfit, and preview a new look without an account.
description: AI Clothes Changer Free lets you explore outfits on a photo before you commit. Upload a clear photo of yourself, choose from 64 wardrobe presets (32 women’s and 32 men’s), upload your own clothing reference, or describe an outfit in text. The studio aims to keep your face, pose, and background while changing clothes. Browse prepared samples with no signup; live generation runs when capacity allows. JPG, PNG, and WebP up to 10 MB. Free to use on the current site with no paid plans.
